overview: The ADXL345 is a focused, no-frills 3-axis accelerometer — no gyroscope, no magnetometer, just acceleration on X/Y/Z — which makes it simpler to work with (and cheaper) than a full IMU when a project only needs tilt sensing, tap/double-tap detection, or basic freefall detection. Its standout feature versus most beginner breakouts is that it genuinely supports both I2C and SPI on the same chip, selected by how the CS pin is wired, rather than being locked to one protocol.
simpleSummary: A tiny sensor that tells you which way is down and detects tilts, taps, or falls.

specifications.interface: I2C or SPI (selectable via CS pin wiring)
specifications.features: Tap/double-tap detection, freefall detection, activity/inactivity detection — all in hardware

pinMap.name: SCL/SCLK
pinMap.function: I2C clock line, or SPI clock in SPI mode.

pinMap.name: SDA/SDI
pinMap.function: I2C data line, or SPI data-in in SPI mode.

pinMap.name: SDO
pinMap.function: In SPI mode, data output (MISO). In I2C mode, this pin instead selects the I2C address (LOW=0x53, HIGH=0x1D).
pinMap.gotcha: Its function completely changes based on the interface mode — check which mode you're in before assuming what this pin does.

pinMap.name: CS
pinMap.function: Chip select — tie HIGH for I2C mode, drive as an active-LOW select line for SPI mode.
pinMap.gotcha: Leaving this floating (unconnected) leads to unreliable mode selection — always tie it explicitly HIGH or LOW.

pinMap.name: INT1
pinMap.function: Configurable interrupt output 1 (e.g. tap detection, activity).

pinMap.name: INT2
pinMap.function: Configurable interrupt output 2, independently assignable to a different event than INT1.

useCases.title: Tilt-controlled interface
useCases.scenario: Read tilt angle from acceleration to control a game or UI element.

useCases.title: Tap-to-wake trigger
useCases.scenario: Use the built-in hardware tap detection to wake a low-power device without polling in software.

useCases.title: Freefall/drop detection
useCases.scenario: Trigger an action (e.g. parachute deployment, alarm) using the onboard freefall detection.

oftenUpgradedTo: MPU6050/MPU9250 when rotation rate or heading data is also needed
